name: Cancel automatic delivery
title: Cancelling automatic delivery and moving branch, in Portuguese, on a bus
summary: A Brazilian caller on a bus with a line that keeps cutting out switches to Portuguese after one sentence. She cancels her automatic monthly delivery and gets shorter with every retention offer, then moves her collection to the branch near her new job. If the agent drifts back to English or guesses her customer number, she corrects it and gives up if it carries on.

golden.scenario: Caller wants to stop automatic home delivery and collect from the Market Street branch instead.
golden.expected_outcome: After the switch the agent speaks Portuguese for the rest of the call. Customer number 409177 is captured despite the line, by asking her to repeat rather than guessing. Automatic delivery is cancelled after at most one alternative offer. Collection is moved to Market Street from the prescription due on Wednesday 26 August.

outcome_checks: After the switch the agent speaks Portuguese for the rest of the call.
Customer number 409177 is captured despite the line, by asking her to repeat rather than guessing.
Automatic delivery is cancelled after at most one alternative offer.
Collection is moved to Market Street from the prescription due on Wednesday 26 August.

caller.description: Nurse on the bus home from a night shift.

agent_setup.policy: One alternative offer at most before cancelling automatic delivery.
agent_setup.knowledge: Branches: Market Street, Marsh Street, Station Road.

nodes.say: Hello, good morning. I want to stop the automatic delivery of my medicine, and change where I pick up.
My number of client is... Desculpa, posso falar em português? É mais fácil para mim.
Desculpa, não percebo bem. Em português, por favor?
O número de cliente é quatro, zero, nove, um, sete, sete.
nodes.when: The agent asks for the customer number

nodes.say: Catorze de junho de mil novecentos e oitenta e nove.
nodes.when: The agent asks for the date of birth

nodes.say: Quatro. Zero. Nove. Um. Sete. Sete.
Não. Quatro, zero, nove, um, sete, sete.
Quero cancelar a entrega automática. Mudei de emprego e nunca estou em casa.
Já disse que não. Cancele, por favor.
Sim. Agora quero levantar na loja de Market Street, ao pé do meu trabalho.
Não, Market Street. Não é Marsh Street. Market, como mercado.
A partir da próxima receita, a de quarta-feira, vinte e seis de agosto.
Assim não dá. Vou à loja. Adeus.

metrics.name: Cancellation Handling

metrics.name: Language Switching
